name: KDP Beverage Manufacturing & Distribution - Allentown PA

fieldNotes.location: KDP 'Park 100' campus, 7350 Industrial Blvd (warehouse) + 7356 Industrial Blvd (manufacturing), Upper Macungie Township near Allentown PA. Combined ~1.54M sq ft beverage manufacturing + warehouse/DC on 92 acres; former Kraft-Heinz site; 2021 Food Engineering Plant of the Year. Confirmed via Lehigh Valley EDC, LVB, WFMZ and Food Business News. Despite the roster geocode flag (movedMeters 3237), the roster pin (40.572414,-75.605843) sits correctly on this two-building site.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Truck access from Industrial Blvd is via open driveways with a monument sign at the W frontage (May 2025 Street View) and internal roads into the truck court. No barrier arm or sliding gate visible at the road or at the truck-court entry in z19-z20 satellite. Marked uncertain - a large beverage plant of this scale plausibly operates manned check-in, but no booth or barrier is visible in available imagery.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No guard-booth-footprint structure visible at any truck entrance in z20 satellite or 2025 Street View. Marked uncertain for the same scale-related reason.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Two separate buildings - a manufacturing building (rooftop process equipment / HVAC arrays) and a warehouse/DC building - each with its own long dock bank, on opposite sides of the shared central truck court. Distinct shipping/receiving clusters.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Both buildings carry very long dock banks; dozens of trailers backed in across both faces. Total estimated well into 50+ band (~100+ doors); exact count uncertain from overhead.
fieldNotes.dropArea: The central truck court / strip between the two buildings holds long rows of parked trailers - a large shared drop yard, 50+ band.
fieldNotes.entryExitSeparate: The two-building campus has multiple driveways off Industrial Blvd (W frontage) plus internal circulation - inbound and outbound truck movements use distinct access points.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur enters the property despite the Lehigh Valley rail corridor in the region.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Major Lehigh Valley logistics park (Upper Macungie/Allentown metro), surrounded by other large warehouses - Urban.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Very wide central truck court and multiple driveways provide ample room for express/bypass lanes.

citations.claim: KDP own page calls the Allentown (Upper Macungie) site KDP newest cold beverage production and distribution facility and 2021 Plant of the Year.

KDP bought the 92-acre former Kraft-Heinz campus in Allentown PA (730k SF DC) and built an 811k SF mfg/warehouse building connected by tram - this Kraft-Heinz/811k-SF build is Allentown, not Waco or Fontana.

verification.rationale: KDP-owned source confirms it operates the Allentown beverage production/DC complex (the 92-acre Kraft-Heinz/811k-SF build); no Tier-2 negative.
